# Real V1 Meta payloads, sanitized

Generated by `script/sanitize_v1_payloads.rb` from real WhatsApp Cloud API webhook
traffic received by V1 on 2026-08-08 (the archived development log, kept outside the
repo).

- **Real:** field names, nesting, value types (numeric `quantity`/`item_price`, empty
  order `text`), status sequence, `pricing` objects, Graph API error bodies.
- **Synthetic:** every phone number, Meta message ID, business/phone-number/catalog ID,
  user ID, display name, trace ID, and any free text other than plain greetings.
  The mapping is deterministic, so relationships are kept: the same real message ID
  always became the same fake one.
- **Not preserved:** raw byte layout. The log stored parsed params, so specs sign the
  re-serialized JSON with a test app secret.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `order.json` | A real cart sent from WhatsApp's native Cart (3 items) |
| `text_greeting.json` | A real "Hi" from a customer |
| `status_sent.json`, `status_delivered.json`, `status_read.json` | Real outbound status webhooks |
| `status_duplicate_delivery_a.json`, `_b.json` | **Meta's real duplicate delivery:** the same `delivered` status for the same message, delivered in two separate POSTs from two Meta hosts in the same second |
| `graph_error_131009.json`, `_131030.json`, `_133010.json` | Real `/messages` error responses V1 received |
